votes.reasoning: publish runs `$(MAKE) release-assets-check` (Makefile:342) after the upload and before `--draft=false`. I ran the target read-only with GH pointed at a fake: all three assets gave exit 0 (the normal path); a missing checksums file gave exit 2 with the '✗ ... no checksums-9.9.9.txt' message; and GH=false gave exit 2 ('could not list assets'). grep -qxF matches whole lines, so a look-alike name does not pass. I did not run publish.

Makefile:346-361 adds a separate, documented `release-assets-check` target listed in .PHONY. publish calls it before `--draft=false`. The check fails closed with a clear message when `gh` fails or when the checksums file or either DMG is missing, and it matches exact names (`grep -qxF`). The CLAUDE.md runbook mentions it.

Makefile:342 runs release-assets-check between the upload and `gh release edit --draft=false`, so a failure leaves the release as a draft that users cannot see. `ship` calls publish, so it inherits the check. The target is in .PHONY. It checks the exact names that the UpdateChecker.pickDMGAsset contract depends on. README:642 and CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md:264 are updated, and AGENTS.md == CLAUDE.md.
